about: I'm a seasoned HRIS professional and PeopleSoft technical expert with over 19 years of hands-on experience in enterprise HR systems. I bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery — designing, developing, and supporting complex PeopleSoft environments for large organizations. From all-around development to production support firefighting, I thrive on solving the hard problems that keep HR running. Beyond PeopleSoft, I bring full-stack development capability and a genuine enthusiasm for technology.

expertise.description: End-to-end Human Capital Management implementations, upgrades, and support — from Core HR to Benefits, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition.
Production support and development for PeopleSoft Financial Management and Supply Chain modules, including integrations and reporting.
Student Information System development and support, including custom extensions, integrations, and self-service enhancements.
ELM module development, configuration, and integration support for enterprise-wide training and learning programs.
Web services design and development on both PeopleSoft and .NET platforms, integration frameworks, and application package architecture.
Deep experience diagnosing and resolving complex production issues across all PeopleSoft pillars under time-critical conditions.
